_comment: 创伤知情教育模拟。依据民法典第1010条、妇女权益保障法及2026年施行的治安管理处罚法第25、50、52、56条等现行规则重构；具体定性和处理结果取决于事实，全部文本待公益律师校对。

title.en: What to Do When Someone Is Sexually Harassed

tagline.en: Five settings, five evidence patterns — practise safety, documentation, reporting, and support without blaming a freeze or escape response.
tagline.zh: 五种场景、五类证据线索——练习安全、记录、投诉与支持，不因僵住或离开而责备受害者。

intro.en: Choose one of five situations. The simulation does not guarantee detention, filing, damages, CCTV availability, or any other outcome. Nothing you choose is saved.
intro.zh: 请选择五种情况之一。练习不会保证拘留、立案、赔偿、监控可用或任何其他结果，你的选择也不会被保存。

narration.en: Which situation do you want to practise?

coach.en: Different settings create different records and safety risks. Speaking, resisting, or collecting evidence in the moment is never an obligation.
coach.zh: 不同场景会留下不同记录，也有不同安全风险。受害者没有义务必须当场发声、反抗或收集证据。

text.en: Text harassment — messaging or social media
text.zh: 文字骚扰——聊天软件或社交平台

text.en: Workplace harassment — colleague or supervisor
text.zh: 职场骚扰——同事或上司

text.en: Acquaintance harassment — unwanted contact in a closed space
text.zh: 熟人骚扰——封闭空间内的不受欢迎接触

text.en: Landlord or visitor enters the home and harasses
text.zh: 房东或来访者入户骚扰

text.en: Stranger harassment on a bus, metro, or crowded public place
text.zh: 公交、地铁及拥挤公共场所的陌生人性骚扰

narration.en: A contact repeatedly sends sexual messages and images after normal work communication.
narration.zh: 一个工作联系人在正常沟通后，反复发送带有性意味的消息和图像。

coach.en: Preserve the account identity, timestamps, full context, and originals before blocking where it is safe to do so. Silence is not consent, and a written refusal is useful but not a legal prerequisite for the conduct to be unwanted.
coach.zh: 在安全允许时，可在拉黑前保存账号身份、时间、完整上下文和原始记录。沉默不等于同意；书面拒绝可能有助于澄清事实，但不是认定“不受欢迎”的必备条件。

text.en: Preserve full records and back up the originals
text.zh: 保存完整记录并备份原始文件

text.en: Block immediately for safety
text.zh: 为保护自己立即拉黑

text.en: Delete everything because seeing it is distressing
text.zh: 因为不愿再看到而删除全部记录

narration.en: The messages continue from another account.
narration.zh: 对方换了账号继续发送。

coach.en: Depending on the conduct, current Public Security Administration Punishments Law Article 50 may be relevant to repeated obscene, insulting, or threatening messages and harassment that disrupts normal life. Article 52 addresses indecent assault. Classification and outcome depend on the evidence and facts.
coach.zh: 根据具体行为，现行治安管理处罚法第 50 条可能涉及反复发送淫秽、侮辱、威胁信息以及影响正常生活的滋扰纠缠；第 52 条规定猥亵行为。具体定性与处理结果取决于事实和证据。

text.en: Report to the platform and keep the confirmation
text.zh: 向平台投诉并保存受理回执

text.en: Make a police report and ask what written receipt is available
text.zh: 向公安机关报案，并询问可取得何种书面回执

text.en: Ask 12338 or 12348 about support and legal options
text.zh: 向 12338 或 12348 了解支持与法律选项

narration.en: A supervisor makes sexual comments, sends private invitations, and touches your shoulder despite visible discomfort.
narration.zh: 一名上司发表性暗示言论、私下邀约，并在你明显不适时触碰你的肩膀。

coach.en: Under Civil Code Article 1010, employers and schools should take reasonable measures to prevent and stop sexual harassment. A time-stamped written complaint can document when the organisation was notified.
coach.zh: 依据民法典第 1010 条，用人单位、学校等应采取合理措施预防和制止性骚扰。带时间戳的书面投诉可以记录单位何时获知情况。

text.en: Write a factual timeline and preserve messages, meeting records, and witness names
text.zh: 记录事实时间线，保存消息、会议记录和证人姓名

text.en: Tell one colleague I trust and ask what they observed
text.zh: 告诉一位可信任同事，并询问对方看到了什么

text.en: I freeze and say nothing in the moment
text.zh: 我当时僵住了，什么也没说

narration.en: You consider asking the organisation to act while protecting yourself from retaliation.
narration.zh: 你考虑要求单位处理，同时防范可能的报复。

text.en: Send a written complaint to the designated channel and keep a copy outside the work account
text.zh: 向指定渠道提交书面投诉，并在工作账号外保留副本

text.en: Ask only for a private verbal chat with HR
text.zh: 只和 HR 私下口头谈一谈

text.en: Get legal advice before deciding how to complain
text.zh: 决定投诉方式前先获得法律咨询

narration.en: An acquaintance blocks the exit and makes unwanted physical contact. You focus on getting out.
narration.zh: 一名熟人挡住出口并做出不受欢迎的身体接触。你只想尽快离开。

coach.en: Getting to safety comes first. Freezing, appeasing, or acting normal to escape are survival responses, not consent. Do not confront the person alone if doing so feels unsafe.
coach.zh: 先安全离开最重要。僵住、顺从求生或为了脱身而表现平静，都是求生反应，不等于同意。如果不安全，不要独自对质。

text.en: Move toward an exit or other people and call someone
text.zh: 向出口或人群移动，并联系他人

text.en: Act calm until I can leave
text.zh: 保持平静，等到能够离开

text.en: Confront the person alone afterwards
text.zh: 事后独自与对方对质

narration.en: After leaving, you remember nearby staff, access logs, messages, and people you contacted.
narration.zh: 离开后，你想起附近工作人员、出入记录、消息和联系过的人。

text.en: Record time and place, preserve messages, and list possible witnesses or CCTV locations
text.zh: 记录时间地点，保存消息，并列出可能的证人或监控地点

text.en: Report and ask for a written receipt, understanding the outcome is case-specific
text.zh: 报案并索要书面回执，同时理解处理结果取决于个案

text.en: Seek support first and decide later
text.zh: 先寻求支持，之后再决定

narration.en: A landlord or visitor enters the home, ignores requests to leave, and behaves sexually toward you.
narration.zh: 房东或来访者进入住所，无视离开要求，并对你做出带有性意味的行为。

coach.en: Prioritise a safe exit and immediate help. Possible records include access control, doorbell or building CCTV, property messages, calls, neighbours, and police attendance. Availability is never guaranteed, so request preservation promptly where safe.
coach.zh: 优先安全离开并寻求即时帮助。可能存在的记录包括门禁、门铃或楼宇监控、物业消息、通话、邻居和出警记录。监控是否可用不能保证，在安全情况下应尽快提出留存请求。

text.en: Go to a neighbour or public area and call 110
text.zh: 前往邻居家或公共区域并拨打 110

text.en: Leave the home and stay somewhere safe
text.zh: 离开住所，到安全地点过夜

text.en: Remain silent until the person leaves
text.zh: 保持沉默，等对方离开

narration.en: You are now outside the immediate situation.
narration.zh: 你已经离开了即时危险。

text.en: Save property messages and request prompt preservation of access and CCTV records
text.zh: 保存物业消息，并尽快请求留存门禁和监控记录

text.en: Tell a trusted person and contact a support service
text.zh: 告知可信任的人，并联系支持服务

text.en: Make a report and keep the receipt and submission list
text.zh: 报案并保留回执和材料提交清单

narration.en: On a crowded bus or metro, a stranger repeatedly presses or touches you, then says it was accidental and starts moving toward the exit.
narration.zh: 拥挤的公交或地铁上，一名陌生人反复贴靠或触碰你，随后声称只是意外，并开始向出口移动。

coach.en: Safety first. You may move toward the driver, staff, security, or other passengers; speaking is optional. Do not chase or follow the person alone. If there is immediate danger or continued following, call 110.
coach.zh: 安全优先。你可以向司机、工作人员、安保或其他乘客移动；开口制止不是义务。不要独自追赶或尾随对方。如有即时危险或对方继续跟踪，拨打 110。

text.en: Move toward staff or other passengers and ask a specific person for help
text.zh: 向工作人员或乘客移动，并明确请一位具体的人帮忙

text.en: Use the emergency intercom or alert staff if available
text.zh: 如设备可用，使用紧急通话装置或通知工作人员

text.en: Freeze or leave at the next staffed, well-lit stop
text.zh: 当下僵住，或在下一处有工作人员且照明良好的站点离开

text.en: Follow the person alone to identify them
text.zh: 独自追踪对方以确认身份

narration.en: The person may leave quickly. Staff and bystanders are unsure what they saw.
narration.zh: 对方可能很快离开，工作人员和旁观者也不确定自己看到了什么。

coach.en: Record route and direction, vehicle or carriage number, station, time, appearance, and exit. Ask witnesses for contact details and request prompt CCTV preservation. Keep original media unchanged; CCTV availability and retention vary.
coach.zh: 可记录线路和方向、车厢或车辆编号、站点、时间、外貌和离开方向；询问证人联系方式，并尽快请求留存监控。保持原始影像不变；监控是否存在及保存期限因地而异。

text.en: Record the route, vehicle or carriage, time, appearance, and exit direction
text.zh: 记录线路、车辆或车厢、时间、外貌和离开方向

text.en: Ask a witness for contact details and ask staff to preserve CCTV
text.zh: 询问证人联系方式，并请工作人员留存监控

text.en: Call 110 because the person is following me after I exit
text.zh: 因对方下车后继续跟踪而拨打 110

text.en: Leave without documenting anything
text.zh: 先离开，不记录任何信息

title.en: You created options without assuming an outcome
title.zh: 你为自己保留了多种选择

summary.en: Records, written complaints, support, and police reports can each serve different purposes. Keep originals and receipts. Whether authorities or a court take action depends on the conduct, evidence, procedure, and applicable law.
summary.zh: 记录、书面投诉、支持服务和报案各有不同作用。应保存原件与回执。有关机关或法院是否采取措施，取决于具体行为、证据、程序与适用法律。

title.en: Support first is a complete choice
title.zh: 先寻求支持也是完整的选择

summary.en: Freezing, leaving, blocking, or deciding later does not make the harassment your fault. You may return to documentation, organisational, platform, police, or civil options after getting support.
summary.zh: 僵住、离开、拉黑或之后再决定，都不会让骚扰成为你的责任。获得支持后，你仍可重新考虑记录、单位、平台、公安或民事路径。

title.en: You preserved leads without chasing alone
title.zh: 你在不独自追赶的情况下保留了线索

summary.en: Route, carriage, time, appearance, exit direction, witness contacts, and a prompt CCTV request can help identify what records exist. None is guaranteed, and leaving safely remains valid even if no evidence was collected.
summary.zh: 线路、车厢、时间、外貌、离开方向、证人联系方式和及时的监控留存请求，有助于查找可能存在的记录。任何材料都不能保证取得；即使没有留证，安全离开仍然是正当选择。

title.en: You treated continued following as an immediate safety risk
title.zh: 你把持续跟踪当作了即时安全风险

summary.en: Stay near staff, security, or other people and share your location with someone you trust if safe. Give 110 your current location and direction of travel; do not confront or follow the person alone.
summary.zh: 尽量留在工作人员、安保或人群附近，并在安全时向可信任的人共享位置。向 110 说明当前位置和移动方向，不要独自对质或追踪。

detail.en: Keep account identity, timestamps, full context, originals, and backups. A single screenshot can omit context, so preserve more where safely possible.
detail.zh: 保存账号身份、时间、完整上下文、原始文件与备份。单张截图可能缺少上下文，在安全允许时可保存更完整记录。

title.zh: 你留下了可追踪的投诉记录

detail.en: Keep the submitted text, attachments, time, recipient, confirmation, and response. A complaint creates a record but does not guarantee a particular result.
detail.zh: 保留提交内容、附件、时间、接收方、受理回执和回复。投诉会形成记录，但不保证特定结果。

basis.en: Civil Code Article 1010 addresses organisational duties to prevent and stop sexual harassment.
basis.zh: 民法典第 1010 条规定了单位预防和制止性骚扰的义务。

title.en: You used an official reporting route
title.zh: 你使用了正式报案渠道

detail.en: Describe the conduct and safety risk, submit available records, review your statement, and ask what receipt or written decision applies. Do not assume reporting guarantees detention or filing.
detail.zh: 说明具体行为与安全风险，提交现有记录，核对陈述，并询问适用的回执或书面决定。不要把报案等同于必然拘留或立案。

basis.en: Depending on the facts, current Public Security Administration Punishments Law Articles 50, 52, or 56 may be relevant.
basis.zh: 根据事实，现行治安管理处罚法第 50、52 或 56 条等条款可能适用。

title.en: You moved toward people who could help
title.zh: 你向能够提供帮助的人移动

detail.en: A driver, station employee, security officer, or specifically identified passenger may help create distance, alert services, or remember what they observed.
detail.zh: 司机、站务人员、安保或被明确请求的乘客，可能帮助拉开距离、联系服务或记录所见情况。

title.zh: 你记录了公共交通特有线索

detail.en: Route, direction, vehicle or carriage, station, time, appearance, and exit direction can narrow requests even if the person left quickly.
detail.zh: 线路、方向、车辆或车厢、站点、时间、外貌和离开方向，即使对方迅速离开，也能帮助缩小查找范围。

title.zh: 你及时提出了留存请求

detail.en: Ask the operator, property manager, platform, or authorities what footage or records exist and how preservation requests are handled. Availability and retention vary; never state a universal number of days.
detail.zh: 向运营方、物业、平台或有关机关询问哪些影像或记录存在，以及如何提出留存请求。是否存在与保存期限均有差异，不应假定统一天数。

title.zh: 删除可能减少可访问的上下文

detail.en: Deleting distressing content is understandable. If recovery is possible, avoid repeated handling and ask a trusted technical or legal professional about safe options.
detail.zh: 删除令人不适的内容是可以理解的。如存在恢复可能，可避免反复查看，并向可信任的技术或法律专业人员了解安全选项。

title.zh: 独自对质可能增加风险

detail.en: Prioritise distance, support, and a plan. Confrontation can change retaliation, safety, and evidence risks and is not required to prove refusal.
detail.zh: 优先保持距离、获得支持并制定计划。对质可能改变报复、安全与证据风险，也不是证明拒绝的必需步骤。

title.en: Do not chase an unknown person alone

detail.en: Move toward staff or other people, record direction from a safe distance if possible, and call 110 for immediate danger or continued following.
detail.zh: 向工作人员或人群移动；如安全可行，从远处记录方向；如有即时危险或持续跟踪，拨打 110。

title.en: A verbal report may be harder to trace
title.zh: 口头反映可能难以追踪

detail.en: If safe, follow up with a factual email or written submission and keep a copy outside the work system. Retaliation risk may justify getting legal advice first.
detail.zh: 如安全可行，可用事实性邮件或书面提交补充，并在工作系统外保留副本。如担心报复，可先寻求法律意见。

realFlow.en: Safety first — move toward staff, security, exits, or other people. Call 110 for immediate danger or continued following.
realFlow.zh: 安全优先——向工作人员、安保、出口或人群移动。如有即时危险或持续跟踪，拨打 110。

realFlow.en: Preserve what already exists — account IDs, URLs, timestamps, full messages, workplace records, route and carriage details, witness contacts, and original media.
realFlow.zh: 保存已经存在的记录——账号 ID、网址、时间、完整消息、工作记录、线路车厢信息、证人联系方式和原始媒体。

realFlow.en: Request time-sensitive records promptly — ask the relevant operator, property manager, employer, platform, or authorities about CCTV, access, complaint, and preservation procedures.
realFlow.zh: 及时请求可能变化的记录——向运营方、物业、单位、平台或有关机关询问监控、门禁、投诉和留存程序。

realFlow.en: Use the route that matches the setting — workplace complaint, platform report, police report, civil consultation, 12338, 12348, social work, or psychological support.
realFlow.zh: 按场景选择路径——单位投诉、平台举报、公安报案、民事咨询、12338、12348、社工或心理支持。

realFlow.en: Keep receipts and decisions — review statements before signing and keep a submission list. Ask a qualified local service about any review or civil route; outcomes are case-specific.
realFlow.zh: 保留回执与决定——签字前核对陈述并保存提交清单。向本地合格服务了解复核或民事路径；处理结果取决于个案。

note.en: Civil Code Article 1010 addresses sexual harassment against another person's will through words, text, images, or physical conduct and provides for civil liability.
note.zh: 民法典第 1010 条规定，违背他人意愿，以言语、文字、图像、肢体行为等方式实施性骚扰的，受害人有权依法请求承担民事责任。

note.en: The revised Public Security Administration Punishments Law took effect on 1 January 2026. Article 25 contains the general six-month discovery period; Article 50 covers specified repeated messages, harassment, following, voyeurism, covert photography, eavesdropping, and dissemination of private information; Article 52 addresses indecent assault; Article 56 addresses illegal sale or provision of personal information.
note.zh: 修订后的治安管理处罚法自 2026 年 1 月 1 日施行。第 25 条规定一般六个月追究期限；第 50 条涵盖特定反复信息、滋扰纠缠、跟踪、偷窥、偷拍、窃听和散布隐私；第 52 条规定猥亵；第 56 条涉及非法出售、提供个人信息。

note.en: A request asking an operator, platform, organisation, or authority to retain relevant records before they are overwritten or deleted. Availability, format, and retention periods vary.
note.zh: 在相关记录被覆盖或删除前，请求运营方、平台、单位或有关机关予以留存。记录是否存在、格式与保存期限均可能不同。

note.en: Automatic survival responses. They are not consent and do not make the survivor responsible for harassment.
note.zh: 自动发生的求生反应，不等于同意，也不会让幸存者对骚扰承担责任。
